key_learning: TWO consecutive stakes failures (R9 + R10) for chalk-doubt flag. Hypothesis from R9 (flag doesn't generalize to stakes with top connections) is now N=2 same direction.

Override of algo's default super box `2-9-6-1` was a mistake. Substituting #8 for #9 (commits to fade) blew up the box. Lesson: don't override the algo's top-N picks based on a single signal whose segmentation hasn't been validated.

Stakes-grade fields with top trainer/jockey combinations behave differently from claiming/maiden fields. The market 'sharp money' that the W-P gap measures is, in stakes, the smart sharps respecting the chalk's pedigree — not a chalk-trap warning.

Real-time betting takeaway: when flag fires on a stakes-grade chalk with Asmussen/Pletcher/Cox/Brown/Mott/Casse/Joseph trainer + top jockey (Irad/J.Ortiz/Prat/Velazquez), TRUST THE CHALK, do not fade.
